thread:
jen: N64 throwback tonight at the mezz? GoldenEye, Smash, Mario Kart. Projector + one CRT available. who's in? :tada:
omar: Heck yes. What time are we thinking?
mel: 6pm works for me. I can bring an extra carrying case + a couple controllers.
sam: I have 3 spare controllers and a rumble pack :thumbsup:
ali: I can bring a power strip and HDMI scaler for the projector. Need any carts?
jen: Yes please — bring any fave carts. I have Ocarina, Mario Kart, and uh... I found a mystery cart in my closet (could be Banjo?) :eyes:
nate: I can haul the CRT but it's heavy. Anyone available to help me move it upstairs?
mel: I can help. Meet at loading dock at 5:45?
sam: 5:45 loading dock works. Also can someone DM @facilities to open the mezz storage door if needed?
jen: I already pinged @facilities earlier, they're good. I'll put in the calendar invite now.
calendar-bot: Booking confirmed — mezzanine reserved 18:00–23:00. Event: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1729998888
jen: quick poll: Smash format? React with :one: for teams, :two: for free-for-all. (reactions = RSVP)
ali: :one:
omar: :two:
mel: :one:
sam: :two:
nate: :one:
jen: Looks like teams wins 3–2. I'll set up brackets. Anyone streaming?
ali: I can stream from my Deck if someone lends a capture card.
sam: I have an Elgato we can use.
jen: Awesome — thanks. Snacks/drinks plan? I'll bring chips + juice.
mel: I'll order pizza if ppl chip in $5 — Venmo @mel-gamer
omar: Count me in, sending $5 now :money_with_wings:
ali: Also posting a dumb meme to hype ppl: https://i.imgur.com/nostalgia.jpg :joy:
jen: Final checklist: CRT + adapter (nate), carry help (mel + sam), controllers (mel/sam), Elgato (sam), power strip/scaler (ali), carts (everyone).
jen: Final reminder: wear comfy shoes for carrying the CRT. See y'all at 6pm! :rocket:
